An umbrella term for various bodily conditions present from birth in which chromosomes, gonads, hormones, body structure, and other characteristics do not fully fit either definition of typical male or female. In medicine, it is also called “disorders of sex development (DSD)” or “variations in sex characteristics.” It concerns bodily characteristics and is separate from Gender identity and Sexual orientation. It does not mean “a third sex,” and it does not confine a person to a particular gender; Gender identity varies from person to person (men, women, Non-binary people, and others; some people are Transgender). It is a separate concept from Transgender, though some people are both, and it is considered part of LGBTQIA+.
